epics.title: Convergence triage canvas
epics.goal: A reviewer sees every concurrent proposal as one comparable set on a single surface — cards, exact counts, the conflict map — with click-first interaction, honest first-load and failure states, and set freshness that converges on server truth.

epics.title: Change-set engine & merge preview
epics.goal: A reviewer can read any proposal's commits, files, and diffs computed server-side against the fork point, trust that collisions are real because the merge was attempted, and preview the landing outcome before committing — no clones, no CLI on the review path.

epics.title: Landing: one click, with receipt
epics.goal: A chosen proposal lands server-side in one click; every attempt yields one of nine unambiguous, numbered outcomes; the reviewed-state and concurrency preconditions make 'what lands is what was reviewed' true, and each landing records its validation evidence.

epics.title: Live platform events
epics.goal: The platform proves it is alive: pushes, forks, and landings flow through a single-consumer, deduped, validated event pipeline to the UI in real time, with polling existing only as the degraded fallback.

epics.title: Judge layer
epics.goal: A reviewer gets three typed advisory signals per proposal — risk, intent-vs-diff, semantic collision — from a server-assembled, pinned, fail-closed judge; chips advise while code decides, and thresholds are calibrated before any gating is trusted.

epics.title: Trust: secrets, intent & provenance
epics.goal: Secret-class values never leave the worker — schema-only rendering, scrubbed free-text channels, withheld folds, 409-blocked landings — while every change-set durably carries its why via the notes mirror and its provenance stays visible.

epics.title: Agent workspaces & harness onboarding
epics.goal: An operator provisions N isolated agent workspaces from one baseline in one command and onboards real agent CLIs — omp, codex, and BYO harnesses — through a machine-legible standard; each workspace pushes independently and emits events.

epics.title: Identity: auth seam, tokens & elevated reveal
epics.goal: The platform is auth-ready and demo-open with zero credential egress: one default-deny authorize() chokepoint, short-lived scoped audited tokens, and elevated reveal existing only behind the seam — enforced before any non-demo data enters.

epics.title: Interactive tour
epics.goal: A first-time viewer learns the model in one sitting: a 10-step stepper that teaches with simulations, renders the real proposal set live, quizzes over it, states honest scope, and never breaks.

epics.title: Operational excellence: demo, submission & governance
epics.goal: The entry can be reproduced and submitted — committed scripts, rehearsed failure paths, a 5–10 minute uninterrupted take and an open-source package — under the platform's binding operating discipline: pinned runtime, declared scope floor, engineering-law governance.

epics.title: Platform API & client protocol
epics.goal: Any client can drive the whole platform through documented, additive-only route shapes that never drift silently; the 11-entity protocol plus push-event surface is the contract the second client later proves.

epics.title: R2 asset tier
epics.goal: A repo can carry large and binary assets without bottlenecking the git fabric: content-addressed R2 blobs with manifests/pointers in Artifacts, integrity fail-closed, lifecycle-safe deletes — clones, change-sets, and the fork-point contract unchanged.

epics.title: Fork community & intent router
epics.goal: A builder declares intent before building and matches it against the fork ecosystem — merge-it / use-as-context / ignore verdicts drive join-don't-restart, with merge-back-to-upstream paths defined.
